nodes.name: Postgres Audit: Check Stored Resumes & Learned Rules

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resume_generations) AS total_resumes_stored,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resume_generations WHERE resume_status IN ('LGTM', 'Approved', 'Approved & Learned')) AS lgtm_approved_resumes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resume_generations WHERE resume_status = 'Updated - Ready for Review') AS reworked_resumes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learned_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE) AS total_learned_rules,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM role_few_shot_library WHERE is_active = TRUE) AS total_few_shot_examples,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(r), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT resume_id, s_no, company_name, position_title, role_category, revision_count, resume_status, last_reviewer_note, updated_at
    FROM resume_generations
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) r) AS latest_stored_resumes,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(l), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT id, section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, company_context, created_at
    FROM learned_rules
    WHERE is_active = TRUE
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) l) AS latest_learned_rules,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(f), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT id, role_category, role_display_name, source_label, created_at
    FROM role_few_shot_library
    WHERE is_active = TRUE
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 5
  ) f) AS latest_promoted_few_shots;

nodes.name: Get Rows Where Resume Status = Needs Rework
Get Rows Where Resume Status = LGTM

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM (
    SELECT
      resume_id, s_no, job_id, company_name, position_title, role_category,
      extracted_jd_keywords, summary_html, skills_html, experience_html,
      marketing_projects_html, certifications_html, education_html, hobbies_html,
      drive_file_id, drive_web_link, COALESCE(revision_count, 1) AS revision_count
    FROM resume_generations
    WHERE (resume_id = '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' AND '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' <> '')
       OR (s_no = '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' AND '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' <> '')
       OR LOWER(TRIM(company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json["Company"] }}'))
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) r) AS cached_resume,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(l)), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT section_name, role_category, rule_instruction
    FROM learned_rules
    WHERE is_active = TRUE
    ORDER BY id ASC
  ) l) AS active_rules;

AI Router: Detect Flagged Section & Distill Rule (Gemini)
Postgres: Save New Rule to learned_rules

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO learned_rules (section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, company_context, is_active)
SELECT
  '{{ $json.primarySectionForRule }}',
  '{{ $json.targetRoleForRule }}',
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  TRUE
WHERE '{{ $json.shouldSaveLearnedRule }}' = 'true'
  AND LENGTH(TRIM($1)) > 5
  AND $1 !~* '\m(for this resume|this resume only|only for this resume|just for this resume)\M'
  AND $2 !~* '\m(for this resume|this resume only|only for this resume|just for this resume)\M'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM learned_rules
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(rule_instruction)) = LOWER(TRIM($1))
       OR (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(triggered_by_comment, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM($2)) AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(company_context, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM($3)))
  );

INSERT INTO resume_generations (
  resume_id, s_no, job_id, company_name, position_title, role_category,
  extracted_jd_keywords, summary_html, skills_html, experience_html,
  marketing_projects_html, certifications_html, education_html, hobbies_html,
  drive_file_id, drive_web_link, revision_count, resume_status, last_reviewer_note, updated_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Re-Compile HTML With Updated Section(s)').last().json.resumeId }}',
  '{{ $('Re-Compile HTML With Updated Section(s)').last().json.sNo }}',
  'N/A',
  $1, $2,
  '{{ $('Re-Compile HTML With Updated Section(s)').last().json.roleCategory }}',
  '{}'::jsonb,
  $3, $4, $5, '', $6, $7, $8,
  '{{ $json.id }}',
  '{{ $json.webViewLink }}',
  {{ $('Re-Compile HTML With Updated Section(s)').last().json.nextRevision }},
  'Updated - Ready for Review',
  $9,

nodes.name: Google Sheets: Update Row with Revised PDF Link
Postgres: Promote Approved Resume to Few-Shot Library

parameters.query:
UPDATE resume_generations
SET resume_status = 'Approved', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE resume_id = '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' OR s_no = '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' OR LOWER(TRIM(company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json["Company"] }}'));

DELETE FROM role_few_shot_library
WHERE source_label IN (
  SELECT 'Approved Resume - ' || company_name || ' (' || position_title || ')'
  FROM resume_generations
  WHERE resume_id = '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' OR s_no = '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' OR LOWER(TRIM(company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json["Company"] }}'))
);

INSERT INTO role_few_shot_library (
  role_category,
  role_display_name,
  include_maerke_stratcomm,
  include_marketing_projects,
  sample_summary_html,
  sample_skills_html,
  sample_experience_html,
  source_label,
  is_active
)
SELECT
  role_category,
  position_title || ' (' || company_name || ')',
  FALSE,
  CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(marketing_projects_html, '')) > 10 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END,
  summary_html,
  skills_html,
  experience_html,
  'Approved Resume - ' || company_name || ' (' || position_title || ')',
  TRUE
FROM resume_generations
WHERE resume_id = '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' OR s_no = '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' OR LOWER(TRIM(company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json["Company"] }}'))
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
